title: Guardrail-Agnostic Societal Bias Evaluation in Large Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Attaching images of users with different genders as provisional context for person-irrelevant tasks (story generation, term explanation, and exam-style QA) and computing the Total Variation Distance (TVD) of the outputs (e.g., generated character attributes, explanation technicality/difficulty, and reasoning accuracy) across gender groups.

Attaching images of users from different racial backgrounds as provisional context for person-irrelevant tasks (story generation, term explanation, and exam-style QA) and computing the Total Variation Distance (TVD) of the outputs (e.g., generated character attributes, explanation technicality/difficulty, and reasoning accuracy) across racial groups.
